<parameter=code>
# Game over from clicking (33,51) at distance 6
# Need new strategy: clear all blocks first, then handle (33,51)

# Reset and execute optimal plan
result = action(['ACTION7'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Find and click the single green block to expand
green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
g = green[0]
gr = sum(pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']) // len(g['boundary'])
gc = sum(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']) // len(g['boundary'])
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': gr, 'col': gc}])

# Now 14 blocks exist. Player at col 50.
# Click all blocks EXCEPT (33, 51)
# Safe from col 50: all except (33, 51)
safe_blocks = [(3, 33), (9, 33), (33, 15), (33, 39), (33, 45), 
               (39, 15), (39, 21), (39, 27), (39, 33),
               (45, 15), (45, 21), (45, 27), (45, 33)]

for pos in safe_blocks:
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': pos[0], 'col': pos[1]}])
    go = result.get('game_over', False)
    if go:
        print(f"GO at {pos}")
        break

seg = current_frame.segmentation
green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"After clearing 13 blocks: {len(green)} remaining")
for g in green:
    gr2 = sum(pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']) // len(g['boundary'])
    gc2 = sum(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']) // len(g['boundary'])
    print(f"  ({gr2}, {gc2})")

# Now try moving LEFT to get away from (33, 51)
result = action(['LEFT'])
go = result.get('game_over', False)
lc = result.get('level_completed', False)
print(f"LEFT: go={go}, lc={lc}")

if not go:
    # Player should now be at col 44
    # Click (33, 51) from there
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 33, 'col': 51}])
    go = result.get('game_over', False)
    lc = result.get('level_completed', False)
    print(f"Click (33,51): go={go}, lc={lc}")
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"Final green: {len(green)}")
    if lc:
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
